programme.title: Bachelor of Advanced Computer Science (Honours) : The University of Western Australia
programme.degree: Bachelor of Advanced Computer Science (Honours); Computer Science major in the Bachelor of Science
programme.notes: kb_top100_list.json has no official_domain for UWA; the university's domain is uwa.edu.au.

english.quote: Minimum overall IELTS score of 6.5, with no band less than 6.0.
english.notes: Admission requirement 'English competency' on the Computer Science major page; university-wide standard.

value.description: No GPA threshold; the threshold is a rank: minimum ATAR 90 (or the equivalent for an international qualification, converted by UWA) for the Bachelor of Advanced Computer Science (Honours); prerequisite Mathematics Methods ATAR.

gpa.notes: ATAR is an admission rank, not a grade average; equivalents for foreign qualifications are not on this page.

tuition.notes: Not published for this course: the course pages say 'International Student Fees There is no current fee information available for this course. Please visit the fee calculator' (https://www.uwa.edu.au/study/courses/computer-science); the fee calculator (www.fees.uwa.edu.au/Calculator) is an interactive tool, not read.

scholarship_exists.quote: provides a fee discount scholarship to encourage and assist eligible high-achieving international students to commence and pursue an undergraduate or postgraduate qualification
scholarship_exists.notes: Undergraduate: 10% tuition discount for equivalent ATAR 85-89.95, 20% for 90 or above; annual, for the normal course duration; assessed with the offer. Listing: applications open 01/07/2026, close 22/12/2026. Partial tuition discount only.
